desc: The Walker's Compact Folding Ultimate Power Muff w/ 24dB Noise Reduction GWP-XPMB has been designed to be the ideal way to hear everything around you. With a sound dampening composite housing, two hi gain omni-directional microphones and independent volume control and frequency tuning, the Walkers Ultimate Power Muff has everything you'll need packed in a compact and lightweight design. For an amazing way to ensure the health of your ears, choose the Walker's 24dB Ultimate Power Muff.
